<thinking>
The task is to extract the name and price of every product on this page as structured data. I'll use the extract action with a schema that captures product name and price.
</thinking>

<action name="extract">
  <schema>
    {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Product name"
          },
          "price": {
            "type": "number",
            "description": "Product price"
          }
        },
        "required": ["name", "price"]
      }
    }
  </schema>
</action>
